explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

i need to get the english equivalents in my text. i have a file containing thousands of text lines, sometimes with XXXXX.
i need something like this:
01,02,03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14.
i tried this, but it does not work:
awk '{for (i=3; i<nf; i++) if ( $i > 100 ) { printf "%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s\n", $i, $i, $i, $i, $i, $i, $i, $i } }'

a:

this should work. you'll want to make sure to match the leading zeros.
awk '{for (i=3; i<= nf; i++) if ($i) print $i; print ""}'
01,02,03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14

in this sample file, the input i made is:
    2, 4, 5
